The partnership will combine PNB's domestic network with Deutsche Bank's global capabilities to support Indian companies' expansion plans.

items.title: GTRI urges CBIC to issue guidelines to resolve Scotch whisky classification issue
items.summary: GTRI has requested the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs to provide guidelines for Scotch whisky classification. There is an ongoing dispute concerning customs duties under the India-UK Comprehensive Economic Trade Agreement. Current classification issues may significantly increase import duties from 75 percent back to 150 percent. Importers are urged to adhere to internationally recognized classifications and established court precedents.

items.title: PLI Auto Scheme records Rs 4,385 cr incentive disbursement in current fiscal: Govt
items.summary: The PLI Scheme for the Automobile and Auto Component Industry has disbursed Rs 4,385.28 crore in the current financial year. Cumulative disbursements under this scheme have reached Rs 6,771.64 crore since its inception. Approved applicants reported investments surpassing the target by achieving Rs 52,806 crore by September 2026. The scheme has generated 77,755 employment opportunities and facilitated incremental sales of Rs 82,993 crore.

items.title: Ahead of FY27 budget, aluminium industry seeks import duty hike on primary metal, scraps, finished products
items.summary: In a pre-budget proposal to the government, the Aluminium Association of India (AAI) has sought an increase in the basic customs duty on primary aluminium and the metal scraps to 10 per cent, and the levy on downstream product imports to 15 per cent, arguing that these measures would significantly reduce forex losses and strengthen the domestic industry.

items.title: PepsiCo India to invest Rs 868 cr in Tamil Nadu to set up food manufacturing facility
items.summary: PepsiCo is set to invest Rs 868 crore in a greenfield food manufacturing facility located in Tamil Nadu. This new facility is expected to begin commercial operations by July 2028 and will enhance PepsiCo's manufacturing capabilities. It will focus on producing popular brands like Lay's and Kurkure to better serve South Indian markets. Additionally, the company aims to expand agricultural partnerships with local farmers for potato cultivation.

items.title: Foxconn clarifies position on contractual dispute with Indian vendor as $15 million claim reaches NCLT
items.summary: In a recent statement, Foxconn has acknowledged a payment dispute with BCD Emprassa over alleged unpaid dues of $15 million. The issue stems from unmet contractual responsibilities and ongoing quality standard failures from the supplier. Despite repeated calls for corrective measures, resolutions have not been achieved, leading to legal action. BCD Emprassa has turned to the National Company Law Tribunal for recovery.

items.title: India's sugar output seen falling to decade low, says industry body
items.summary: India's sugar production is expected to fall to a decade low of 26.52 million metric tons in the 2026/27 season, down from 27.97 million tons a year earlier, as lower rainfall is likely to hurt sugar cane yields in key growing states, the Indian Sugar & Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association said.

items.title: Royal Enfield signs Rs 1,000 crore MoU with Tamil Nadu government for EV expansion
items.summary: Royal Enfield has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with the Tamil Nadu government. The investment of Rs 1,000 crore aims to accelerate the company's electric vehicle development over seven years. This investment will create up to 500 job opportunities, contributing to the socio-economic growth of Tamil Nadu. The initiative follows a commitment for brownfield expansion at its Cheyyar facility for annual motorcycle production.

items.title: RBI hunts for possible '$2 million loophole' in importers' forex transactions
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has stepped up scrutiny of importers' forex transactions amid concerns that companies may be splitting deals below the $2 million threshold to avoid additional reserve requirements. The move follows a sharp fall in average dollar-buying transaction sizes since October 10, even as the number of deals has risen, prompting fresh compliance checks on banks.

items.title: Poultry body seeks stock limits on maize, soyabean; warns of Rs 40-50/kg rise in chicken price
items.summary: The All India Poultry Breeders Association is urging the government to impose stock limits on maize and soyabean. Rising feed prices have caused significant distress for poultry farmers amid claims of artificial scarcity. Many poultry farms are shutting down as production costs exceed earnings from chicken sales. The association estimates that chicken prices could increase significantly if conditions do not improve soon.

items.title: Cipla, Teva get USFDA nod for first generic Flovent HFA asthma inhaler
items.summary: Cipla announced the approval of Fluticasone HFA metered dose inhaler for asthma treatment by the US health regulator. This marks the first generic equivalent to Flovent HFA, expanding treatment options for patients aged four and older. The product was developed in collaboration with Teva Pharmaceuticals, who will handle its commercialization in the US. The US market for this medication is valued at approximately USD 350 million.

items.title: Strong economic growth, supportive policies to sustain NBFC credit demand: Fitch
items.summary: Fitch Ratings has projected stable operating conditions for Indian non-banking finance companies due to strong domestic economic growth. The growth forecast remains robust despite the challenges posed by inflation and rising interest rates. Fitch highlights that credit demand will be sustained by a supportive policy framework. Additionally, some near-term weakness is expected in small business and rural lending. However, elevated funding costs are anticipated to be managed effectively.

items.title: India allocates 8,606 tonnes of raw cane sugar for export to US under Tariff Rate Quota scheme
items.summary: India has allocated 8,606 metric tonnes of raw cane sugar for export to the US under the Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ) scheme for the 2027 US fiscal year, running from October 1, 2026, to September 30, 2027. The scheme allows shipments at zero or concessional import duty.

Chinese electric vehicles have gained significant market share in South Korea, capturing over 43% of new registrations.

items.title: India's economic activity growth hits four-year high of 9% in October: Jefferies
items.summary: India's economic activity growth hit a four-year high of 9% year-on-year in October. The increase was largely attributed to strong industrial activity and a delayed festive season. However, rural demand indicators remained weak due to a subdued monsoon. While bank credit growth reached a nearly 12-year high, inflationary pressures intensified simultaneously. Overall, the report highlights a mixed outlook for future economic activity amidst varying consumer behaviors.
